description: S462 review: a one-statement handler whose if/else is NESTED — the dangling `else` of `if (@c) if (@d) a else b` binds to the inner `if` — takes the statement path and runs the right arm (@c true, @d false → 2). Pre-fix the reroute looked only at a top-level if-with-else, so this reached the text path and emitted `_scrml_reactive_set("x", 1 else …)` (E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC).
rationale: An `else` binds to the nearest unmatched `if`; §5.2.3 an inline block's statements SHALL run.
